description: Sends an email invitation to join the workspace as a member. The invitation lasts 7 days. Inviting the same address again sends a fresh email. Admin only, on a paid plan. Send an idempotency_key. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first answer and does not act again.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string you make for this request, such as a UUID. Send the same key when you retry, and Debriefing returns the first answer instead of acting twice.

name: invite_member

replayed.description: True when this answer repeats an earlier call with the same idempotency_key.

title: Invite a teammate
